entries.title: The Riftbreaker
entries.definitive_edition: The Riftbreaker Complete Pack on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with Workshop/mod tools and all current DLC.

primary.version: Complete Pack / current Windows PC build with all campaign DLC
primary.why: The Riftbreaker launched on October 14, 2021 across Windows PC, Windows Apps, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series, with same-day platform releases confirmed across Steam, PlayStation, and Xbox storefronts. The Windows PC Steam route includes Online Co-op, LAN Co-op, Steam Workshop, a level editor, and a Complete Pack containing Heart of the Swamp, Into The Dark, and Metal Terror. Console versions are valid, especially Xbox Series X|S with 4K, ray tracing, and 60 fps support, but Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it combines all current DLC with Workshop/mod tools, capture control, and the richest feature surface.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC Complete Pack or install the base game plus Metal Terror, Into The Dark, and Heart of the Swamp. Use console versions only as convenience routes, not as the main archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam/GOG availability, Complete Pack DLC, Workshop, level editor, Online Co-op, LAN Co-op, and mod tooling.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete and flexible archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: A Windows Apps release exists from 2021.
all_releases.reason: secondary: content-valid Windows ecosystem route, but Steam/GOG Windows PC remains better for modding, Workshop, and archive control.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 release with a storefront Complete Edition containing Metal Terror, Into The Dark, and Heart of the Swamp.
all_releases.reason: secondary: good complete console route, but PC has the stronger archive feature set.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X|S release with 4K Ultra HD, ray tracing, 60 fps+, and keyboard/mouse support listed on Xbox.
all_releases.reason: secondary: strong console route, but PC remains primary because of DLC packaging, Workshop/mod tools, and capture flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive story or mission content was found; the main choice is PC tooling and complete-DLC convenience versus console convenience.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster split was found. Install all three campaign DLC packs for the complete current route.
